hypotheses.H_sequence: A second mandatory 31B LlmAgent review stage can observe current diff and run a narrow model-visible native test before patch submission, overcoming optional Skill non-uptake
hypotheses.H_budget: Sequential stages incur extra model tokens and may reduce coder exploration enough to hurt actual resolved issues
hypotheses.H_generalization: If resolver improves, it may reflect task/sampling effects instead of targeted verification; an entirely disjoint task cohort is required before score claims
